name: Bulldozer

attack.name: China-Shop Charge
attack.telegraph: Lowers its head, paws the earth. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything.

weaknesses: it never goes around — position accordingly

edible.note: Pork is pork. Smoke it; it keeps for weeks. The quills make excellent awls.

codexStages.unknown: Something heavy moved in the thicket. Then a tree fell over for no reason.
codexStages.observed: Feral hog. The System observed 'bull in a china shop' and concluded destruction is the point. It charges through obstacles — trees, fences, you. It cannot be deterred, only redirected.
codexStages.slain: Thornback Boar. Moves: China-Shop Charge (heavy, telegraphed, destroys cover), Trample (close range after a missed charge), Retreat (below 25% hp, may return). It will not go around. Use that. Flanks are soft — harry it, then strike. Meat: excellent. The quills make fine awls.

attack.name: Silent Rush
attack.telegraph: No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving.

edible.note: Edible but lean. The old taboo itches; hunger doesn't care.

codexStages.unknown: The woods went silent all at once. Not quiet — silent. Like the world holding its breath.
codexStages.observed: Feral dogs. The System classified vocalization as 'inefficient' and removed it. They coordinate without sound — watch the lead animal's ears. They are still loyal. Just not to you.
codexStages.slain: Hushwolf. Moves: Silent Rush (ambush opener, heavy), Harass (pack circles, light hits), Withdraw (if the lead falls). They fear fire — they remember being dogs. Wound the lead and the pack breaks.

name: Highbeam Deer

attack.name: Ocular Discharge
attack.telegraph: It freezes. Like a deer in headlights. Light gathers behind its eyes. It is not frozen. It is aiming.

weaknesses: skittish at range before it locks on

edible.note: Venison. The best meat in the woods, and the saddest. Thank it.

codexStages.unknown: A deer. It froze like a deer in headlights. The light did not stop gathering.
codexStages.observed: Whitetail. The System observed the freeze response and classified it as ocular beam charging. It was wrong about the 'beam' — and right that you should move. When it freezes, it is aiming. Antlers never shed: the System classified them as permanent equipment.
codexStages.slain: Gallowdeer. Moves: Ocular Discharge (telegraphed by the freeze — MOVE), Antler Sweep (close range), Bolt (flees at 50% hp). Never let it finish aiming. The meat is worth the sorrow. Thank it.
